description: This file defines the KeyboardShortcutManager class and related internal static class for managing keyboard shortcuts, key bindings, and UI interactions within the CalculatorApp, including handling key events, shortcut registration, and button visual feedback.

classes.name: KeyboardShortcutManager
classes.description: Manages keyboard shortcuts, key bindings, and related UI interactions in the CalculatorApp.

methods.name: LightUpButtons
methods.description: Lights up all buttons in the provided range by changing their visual state temporarily.

methods.name: LightUpButton
methods.description: Changes a button's visual state to 'Pressed' briefly to provide visual feedback.

methods.name: RunFirstEnabledButtonCommand
methods.description: Executes the command of the first enabled button in a collection.

methods.name: RunButtonCommand
methods.description: Executes the command associated with a button, toggling states if applicable.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Sets up event handlers for keyboard input and registers a new app view ID.

methods.name: IgnoreEscape
methods.description: Sets flags to ignore the next Escape key press.

methods.name: HonorEscape
methods.description: Clears ignore flags for Escape key handling.

methods.name: HonorShortcuts
methods.description: Enables or disables shortcut handling.

methods.name: DisableShortcuts
methods.description: Disables or enables shortcut handling, with deferred mode if user input is ongoing.

methods.name: UpdateDropDownState
methods.description: Updates the state indicating whether a dropdown menu is open.

methods.name: RegisterNewAppViewId
methods.description: Registers a new application view ID and initializes related shortcut mappings.

methods.name: OnWindowClosed
methods.description: Removes shortcut mappings associated with a closed window view.

methods.name: OnCharacterPropertyChanged
methods.description: Handles changes to character shortcut properties, updating internal mappings.

methods.name: OnVirtualKeyPropertyChanged
methods.description: Handles changes to virtual key properties, updating internal mappings.

methods.name: OnVirtualKeyControlChordPropertyChanged
methods.description: Handles changes to control chord virtual key properties.

methods.name: OnVirtualKeyShiftChordPropertyChanged
methods.description: Handles changes to shift chord virtual key properties.

methods.name: OnVirtualKeyAltChordPropertyChanged
methods.description: Handles changes to alt chord virtual key properties.

methods.name: OnVirtualKeyControlShiftChordPropertyChanged
methods.description: Handles changes to control+shift chord virtual key properties.

methods.name: CanNavigateModeByShortcut
methods.description: Determines if navigation mode can be changed via shortcut based on current UI state.

methods.name: NavigateModeByShortcut
methods.description: Performs navigation mode change based on shortcut key and modifier states.

methods.name: OnCharacterReceivedHandler
methods.description: Handles character input received event.

methods.name: OnKeyDownHandler
methods.description: Handles key down events, executing shortcuts or special commands.

methods.name: OnKeyUpHandler
methods.description: Handles key up events, managing shortcut state.

methods.name: OnAcceleratorKeyActivated
methods.description: Handles system accelerator key activation, e.g., Alt+Key shortcuts.

methods.name: GetCurrentKeyDictionary
methods.description: Returns the appropriate shortcut dictionary based on modifier keys pressed.

methods.name: EqualRange
methods.description: Retrieves all items matching a key from a sorted dictionary.

methods.name: Insert
methods.description: Inserts a key-value pair into a sorted dictionary, appending to list if key exists.
